evidence.what_it_exercises: Asserts exact shares and their sum for five non-negative totals with positive weights.
Property: shares sum to the total, but totals are drawn from 0 to 10**7 only.
Asserts the remainder cent goes to the largest fractional share.

missing_input_classes.name: total_cents:negative
missing_input_classes.description: A negative total, as a refund posts, e.g. -100.
missing_input_classes.why_likely: int() truncates negative shares toward zero and the negative remainder slice adds cents, so allocate_cents(-100, [1, 2]) returns [-32, -66], which sums to -98.

missing_input_classes.name: weights:all-zero
missing_input_classes.why_likely: sum(weights) is 0 and the division raises ZeroDivisionError instead of a clear error.

missing_input_classes.name: weights:nan-element
missing_input_classes.why_likely: int(nan) raises ValueError: cannot convert float NaN to integer, from deep inside the split.

import pytest

from ledger.billing.allocate import allocate_cents


def test_allocate_cents_rejects_all_zero_weights():

        allocate_cents(100, [0, 0])
